anchors.premises: NormedAddCommGroup E; f : R -> E -> E; t0 in Icc tmin tmax; nonnegative a,r,L,K.
anchors.conclusion: Prop record: K-Lipschitz on closedBall x0 a; continuity in time there; RHS norm <=L there; L*max(tmax-t0,t0-tmin)<=a-r.
anchors.boundary: No existence by the record itself; all bounds and same-space realization must be supplied.
anchors.exact_source_statement:
structure IsPicardLindelof {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    (f : ℝ → E → E) {tmin tmax : ℝ} (t₀ : Icc tmin tmax) (x₀ : E) (a r L K : ℝ≥0) : Prop where
  /-- The vector field at any time is Lipschitz with constant `K` within a closed ball. -/
  lipschitzOnWith : ∀ t ∈ Icc tmin tmax, LipschitzOnWith K (f t) (closedBall x₀ a)
  /-- The vector field is continuous in time within a closed ball. -/
  continuousOn : ∀ x ∈ closedBall x₀ a, ContinuousOn (f · x) (Icc tmin tmax)
  /-- `L` is an upper bound of the norm of the vector field. -/
  norm_le : ∀ t ∈ Icc tmin tmax, ∀ x ∈ closedBall x₀ a, ‖f t x‖ ≤ L
  /-- The time interval of validity -/
  mul_max_le : L * max (tmax - t₀) (t₀ - tmin) ≤ a - r

theorem CUBIC_POSITIVE_TIME_ACCUMULATION
    {y z d : ℝ → ℝ} {ν κ T τ M : ℝ}
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hτ : 0 < τ) (hτT : τ ≤ T) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hy : ContinuousOn y (Icc 0 T))
    (hz : ContinuousOn z (Icc 0 T))
    (hd : ContinuousOn d (Icc 0 T))
    (hynonneg : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, 0 ≤ y t)
    (hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 T, HasDerivAt y (d t) t)
    (hcubic : ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 T, d t + ν * z t ^ 2 ≤ κ * y t ^ 3)
    (hbudget : (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..T, y t ^ 2) ≤ M) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc τ T,
      y t + ν * (∫ r in τ..t, z r ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (M / τ) * Real.exp (κ * M) := by
  have hT : 0 ≤ T := hτ.le.trans hτT
  have hy2i : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => y t ^ 2) volume 0 T :=
    (hy.pow 2).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hT
  have hτbudget : (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..τ, y t ^ 2) ≤ M :=

  obtain ⟨s, hs, hseed⟩ := continuous_exists_point_le_integral_bound hτ
    ((hy.pow 2).mono (Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl hτT)) hτbudget
  have hsT : s ≤ T := hs.2.trans hτT
  have hmap : MapsTo (fun r : ℝ => r + s) (Icc 0 (T - s)) (Icc 0 T) := by
    intro r hr

finite coefficient family, without a reality or solenoidality assumption. -/
theorem SIX_CHANNEL_FINITE_ENSTROPHY_EQ (N : ℕ) (a : FourierCoeff) :
    sixEnstrophy N a = physicalEnstrophy (finiteSynthesis N a) := by
  change (∑ A : Fin 6, physicalEnstrophy (physicalChannel N A a)) = _
  rw [physicalEnstrophy_eq_ofReal_integral (finiteSynthesis_contDiff N a),
    SIX_CHANNEL_FINITE_REAL_ENSTROPHY_EQ,

      integral_nonneg (gradientSquareDensity_nonneg (physicalChannel N A a)))]

  exact physicalEnstrophy_eq_ofReal_integral (physicalChannel_contDiff N A a)

theorem critical_smooth_integral_inner_gradient_eq_zero
    (v : Field) (f : Vec → ℝ)
    (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hvp : SpatialPeriodic v) (hfp : SpatialPeriodic f)
    (hdiv : ∀ x : Vec, divergence v x = 0) :
    (∫ x in unitCube, inner ℝ (v x) (gradient f x)) = 0 := by
  let F : Fin 3 → Vec → ℝ := fun j x => v x j * f x
  have hF (j : Fin 3) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (F j) :=
    (((EuclideanSpace.proj j : Vec →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff).comp hv).mul hf
  have hFp (j : Fin 3) : SpatialPeriodic (F j) := by
    intro x i
    change v (x + unitVector i) j * f (x + unitVector i) = v x j * f x
    rw [hvp, hfp]
  have hD (j : Fin 3) (x : Vec) :
      fderiv ℝ (F j) x (unitVector j) =
        v x j * fderiv ℝ f x (unitVector j) + coordinateDerivative v j x j * f x := by
    have hdv := (EuclideanSpace.proj j : Vec →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.comp x
      ((hv.differentiable (by simp)) x).hasFDerivAt
    have hd := hdv.mul (((hf.differentiable (by simp)) x).hasFDerivAt)
    have hdf : fderiv ℝ (F j) x =
        v x j • fderiv ℝ f x + f x •
          ((EuclideanSpace.proj j : Vec →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp (fderiv ℝ v x)) := by
      simpa only [F, Function.comp_def, EuclideanSpace.coe_proj, Pi.mul_def] using hd.fderiv

  obtain ⟨K, hK, hb⟩ := CRITICAL_SMOOTH_L6_FOURTH_BOUND
  refine ⟨10 * K, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro v hv hp hz

  have hE0 : 0 ≤ physicalEnergy v := by
    rw [physicalEnergy_eq_integral_norm_sq]

  have hE2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hE0 hE 2
  calc
    _ ≤ K * (9 * physicalDissipation v ^ 2 + physicalEnergy v ^ 2) := hb v hv hp

      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add le_rfl hE2) hK.le

    (μ : Measure ℝ) (u : ℝ → Field)
    (hregular : ∀ᵐ t ∂μ,
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (u t) ∧ SpatialPeriodic (u t) ∧ MeanZero (u t))
    (hDmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => physicalDissipation (u t)) μ)
    (hbudget : (∫⁻ t, ExtendedFourierEnstrophy (datumFourierCoeff (u t)) ^ 2 ∂μ) <
      (⊤ : ℝ≥0∞)) :

structure InitialClassicalFront (ν T : ℝ) (a : Field)
    (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure) : Prop where
  velocity_smooth :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (initialFrontSpacetime T)
  pressure_smooth :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => p z.1 z.2) (initialFrontSpacetime T)
  velocity_periodic : ∀ t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, SpatialPeriodic (u t)
  pressure_periodic : ∀ t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, SpatialPeriodic (p t)
  divergence_free : ∀ t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ x : Vec, divergence (u t) x = 0
  equation : ∀ t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ x : Vec,
    timeDerivative u t x + convection (u t) x + SingularClosure.gradient (p t) x =
      ν • laplacian (u t) x
  initial : u 0 = a
  velocity_mean_zero : ∀ t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, MeanZero (u t)
  pressure_mean_zero : ∀ t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, PressureMeanZero (p t)

theorem homogeneousL6FourthConstant_bound
    (v : Field) (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v) (hp : SpatialPeriodic v)
    (hz : MeanZero v) :
    criticalSpatialNorm 6 v ^ 4 ≤ homogeneousL6FourthConstant * physicalDissipation v ^ 2 :=
  SMOOTH_MEAN_ZERO_HOMOGENEOUS_L6_FOURTH.choose_spec.2 v hv hp hz

/-- Homogeneous domination works for an arbitrary time measure; no finite
time-measure or kinetic-energy integrability premise is necessary. -/
theorem homogeneous_l6_fourth_integrable_of_dissipation_square
    (μ : Measure ℝ) (u : ℝ → Field)
    (hregular : ∀ᵐ t ∂μ,
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (u t) ∧ SpatialPeriodic (u t) ∧ MeanZero (u t))
    (hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => criticalSpatialNorm 6 (u t)) μ)
    (hD : Integrable (fun t => physicalDissipation (u t) ^ 2) μ) :
    Integrable (fun t => criticalSpatialNorm 6 (u t) ^ 4) μ := by
  apply (hD.const_mul homogeneousL6FourthConstant).mono' (hmeas.pow 4)
  filter_upwards [hregular] with t ht
  change ‖criticalSpatialNorm 6 (u t) ^ 4‖ ≤
    homogeneousL6FourthConstant * physicalDissipation (u t) ^ 2
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (pow_nonneg (criticalSpatialNorm_nonneg 6 _) 4)]
  exact homogeneousL6FourthConstant_bound (u t) ht.1 ht.2.1 ht.2.2

  (∫⁻ t in Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, ExtendedFourierEnstrophy (c t) ^ 2) < (⊤ : ℝ≥0∞)

/-- The pointwise physical Parseval identity transfers an extended Fourier
budget to integrability of the square of actual physical dissipation. -/
theorem dissipation_square_integrable_of_fourier_budget
    (μ : Measure ℝ) (u : ℝ → Field) (c : ℝ → FourierCoeff)
    (hD : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => physicalDissipation (u t)) μ)
    (hParseval : ∀ᵐ t ∂μ,
      physicalDissipation (u t) = (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) * FourierEnstrophy (c t))
    (hExtended : ∀ᵐ t ∂μ,
      ENNReal.ofReal (FourierEnstrophy (c t)) = ExtendedFourierEnstrophy (c t))
    (hbudget : (∫⁻ t, ExtendedFourierEnstrophy (c t) ^ 2 ∂μ) < (⊤ : ℝ≥0∞)) :
    Integrable (fun t => physicalDissipation (u t) ^ 2) μ := by
  have heq :
      (∫⁻ t, ENNReal.ofReal (physicalDissipation (u t) ^ 2) ∂μ) =
        ENNReal.ofReal ((4 * Real.pi ^ 2) ^ 2) *
          (∫⁻ t, ExtendedFourierEnstrophy (c t) ^ 2 ∂μ) := by
    calc
      _ = ∫⁻ t, ENNReal.ofReal ((4 * Real.pi ^ 2) ^ 2) *
          ExtendedFourierEnstrophy (c t) ^ 2 ∂μ := by
        apply lintegral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [hParseval, hExtended] with t hp he

theorem finite_cap_gluing
    (ν T δ : ℝ) (a : Field) (u v : Velocity) (p q : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p) (K : ClassicalTail ν δ v q)
    (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) (hδT : δ < T)
    (huv : ∀ r ∈ Ioo δ T, u r = v r)
    (hpq : ∀ r ∈ Ioo δ T, p r = q r) :
    ∃ (U : Velocity) (P : Pressure), GlobalSmoothNSE ν a U P ∧
      (∀ r ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, U r = u r ∧ P r = p r) ∧
      ∀ r : ℝ, (δ + T) / 2 ≤ r → U r = v r ∧ P r = q r := by
  let η : ℝ := (δ + T) / 2
  have hη0 : 0 < η := by dsimp [η]; linarith
  have hδη : δ < η := by dsimp [η]; linarith
  have hηT : η < T := by dsimp [η]; linarith
  refine ⟨finiteCapSplice η u v, finiteCapSplice η p q,
    finite_cap_splice_global_smooth ν T δ η a u v p q H K hη0 hδη hηT huv hpq, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro r hr
    by_cases h : r < η
    · constructor <;> simp only [finiteCapSplice, if_pos h]
    · have hδr : δ < r := hδη.trans_le (le_of_not_gt h)

no_substitution_rules: Fixed-N existence is not a cutoff-uniform physical local lifespan.
H^(r+2)->H^r smoothness is not same-space Banach ODE local existence.
Compactness requires uniform bounds/moduli and does not itself recover nonlinear PDE, pressure, trace or smoothness.
A scalar cubic estimate consumes its derivative/cubic premises; it does not prove them for NSE.
One physical-path Fourier budget is not AX6 uniform Galerkin budget.
Existing global-horizon Sobolev flow/regularity assumptions are not a local construction.
Generic Zorn/gluing/ODE time translation is not a physical extension theorem.
R0 accepts an actual cap; it does not produce that cap from the WFB budget.
Strict cutoff<Tmax is sufficient; do not insert two-sided analytic admission or 2*cutoff<Tmax.
Extended nonnegative sums/integrals retain infinity; totalized real integrals are not finiteness predicates.
Only b<Tmax is available for closed-slab scalar estimates; do not assume endpoint regularity.
Use one fixed LH witness to compare fronts and one fixed global R0 witness for whole-trajectory agreement.
